description: Start a prepaid-credits top-up so every tool keeps working after the free trial (20 free calls a day). Use when a tool says the free calls or credit have run out, or the user asks to buy credit; to see what's left, use `balance` instead. Creates a payment request only: it returns the exact USDC amount and address to send (Base or Solana) and a QR-code page, and nothing is charged unless the user sends that payment, which is credited about 15 minutes after it confirms. Without a key in the server URL it also creates an API key (shown once) and the new server URL to use; with one (e.g. a free key), it tops up that same key, so your connector URL stays the same, and reuses a top-up still waiting for payment. Free to call.

amountUsd.description: Dollars of credit to buy: suggest $2, $5, $10 ($10+ gets +10% bonus credit). Minimum $1. Default $2.

network.description: Where you'll send USDC from. Default base.

name: topup

apiKey.description: New API key (only when the server URL had none). Shown once; keep it secret.

checkoutUrl.description: For method "card": the secure card checkout page (hosted by the payment provider).

expires.description: When this payment request expires (ISO 8601 time).

orderId.description: For method "card": the order id; credit arrives on the key as soon as the payment completes.

payPage.description: Web page with a QR code and live payment status.

paymentUri.description: Wallet payment link with the amount and address filled in.

amount.description: USDC amount to send, all six decimals (it identifies the payment).

network.description: Network to send on (Base or Solana).

to.description: Our wallet address to send to.

serverUrl.description: MCP server URL carrying the new key, to use from now on.

topupId.description: Id of this top-up; its QR-code page is payPage.

title: Top up credits (free to call)
